A Module instance is used to store all the information related to an LLVM module.

detaileddescription.para: Modules are the top level container of all other LLVM Intermediate Representation (IR) objects. Each module directly contains a list of globals variables, a list of functions, a list of libraries (or other modules) this module depends on, a symbol table, and various data about the target's characteristics.

A module maintains a GlobalList object that is used to hold all constant references to global variables in the module. When a global variable is destroyed, it should have no entries in the GlobalList. The main container class for the LLVM Intermediate Representation.
